mapper.select: SELECT t1.order_id, t3.table_id, t4.store_id, t5.user_id, t4.store_name, t3.table_number_prefix, t3.table_number, t5.nick_name, t5.user_name, t5.phonenumber, t1.actual_pay, t1.pay_type, t1.pay_time, t1.order_status, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'order_detail_id', t2.order_detail_id, 'product_id', t2.product_id, 'product_name', t6.product_name, 'product_cover_url', t6.product_cover, 'product_quantity', t2.product_quantity, 'product_price', t2.product_price, 'specification', t2.specification ) ) AS order_details FROM ms_order AS t1 JOIN ms_order_detail AS t2 ON t1.order_id = t2.order_id JOIN ms_table AS t3 ON t1.table_id = t3.table_id JOIN ms_store AS t4 ON t4.store_id = t3.store_id JOIN sys_user AS t5 ON t1.user_id = t5.user_id JOIN ms_product AS t6 ON t2.product_id = t6.product_id ${ew.customSqlSegment} GROUP BY t1.order_id ORDER BY t1.order_id ASC, t2.cumulative_add_count ASC

SELECT t1.order_id,t3.table_id,t4.store_id,t5.user_id, t4.store_name, #门店名 t1.pickup_number, #取餐号 CONCAT(t3.table_number_prefix, "-", t3.table_number) AS table_number, #桌位号 t1.diners_number, #就餐人数 t1.order_number, #订单号 SUM(t2.cumulative_add_count_sum) AS product_total, #商品总数 t1.product_total_price, #商品总价 t1.points_deduction, #积分抵扣 t1.actual_pay, #实际支付 t1.create_time, #创建时间 t1.pay_time, #支付时间 t1.pay_type, #支付类型 JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'cumulative_add_count', t2.cumulative_add_count, 'products', t2.products )) AS order_items #每次下单订单项 FROM ms_order AS t1 JOIN ( SELECT t0.order_id, #所属订单id t0.cumulative_add_count, #本次加菜数 0表示第一次下单 COUNT(t0.order_detail_id) AS cumulative_add_count_sum, #本次点餐数 JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'order_detail_id', t0.order_detail_id, #订单详情id 'product_quantity', t0.product_quantity, #商品数量 'total_amount', t0.total_amount, #商品总价 'product_id', t0.product_id, #商品id 'product_name', t0.product_name, #商品名称 'specification', t0.specification, #商品规格 'product_price', t0.product_price, #商品价格 'product_total_price', t0.product_price*t0.total_amount, #商品价格 'create_time', t0.create_time #创建时间 )) AS products #每次下单订单项 FROM ms_order_detail AS t0 GROUP BY t0.order_id, t0.cumulative_add_count ) AS t2 ON t1.order_id = t2.order_id JOIN ms_table AS t3 ON t1.table_id = t3.table_id JOIN ms_store AS t4 ON t4.store_id = t3.store_id JOIN sys_user AS t5 ON t1.user_id = t5.user_id ${ew.customSqlSegment} GROUP BY t1.order_id ORDER BY t1.order_id ASC, t2.cumulative_add_count ASC

SELECT ms_order.order_id, ms_store.store_name, ms_order.order_number, ms_table.table_number, ms_order.actual_pay, ms_order.pickup_number,
CONCAT(ms_order.user_id, '|', IFNULL(sys_user.nick_name, '')) AS userIdAndNickname, CONCAT(IFNULL(sys_user.user_name, ''), '|', IFNULL(sys_user.phonenumber, '')) AS usernameAndPhone,
ms_order_detail.product_image, CONCAT(ms_order_detail.product_name, ' - ', IFNULL(ms_order_detail.specification, '')) AS productNameAndSpecification, CONCAT('￥', ms_order_detail.product_price, ' * ', ms_order_detail.product_quantity) AS productPriceAndQuantity,
ms_order.pay_type, ms_order.buy_type, ms_order.reserve_pick_time, ms_order.order_status, ms_order.pay_time, ms_order.create_time FROM ms_order INNER JOIN ms_store ON ms_order.store_id = ms_store.store_id INNER JOIN ms_table ON ms_store.store_id = ms_table.store_id AND ms_order.table_id = ms_table.table_id INNER JOIN sys_user ON ms_order.user_id = sys_user.user_id INNER JOIN ms_order_detail ON ms_order.order_id = ms_order_detail.order_id
ORDER BY ms_order.create_time DESC, ms_order.order_id DESC, ms_order_detail.order_detail_id ASC
